posts.title: Frédéric Lordon: French Leave?
posts.description: The European Union does not like left-wing governments, except, naturally, those that happen to be right-wing. Of course, it vehemently denies this: what an outrageous suggestion! But we may soon have occasion to judge for ourselves. A left-wing government could come to power in France, and a real one, of the kind the EU is not accustomed to dealing with. The reception it gets would quickly tell us just how tolerant the EU really is. We can venture a prediction: such a government would be poorly received. Continue Reading HERE

posts.title: Out Loud: Costa Rica Detains Francesca Albanese Over “Links to Terrorist Acts”
posts.description: A country with no army since 1948 held the UN expert documenting Israel’s genocide in Gaza at its airport on a secret terror alert, while asking the world to make its candidate UN Secretary-General. Read Article HERE
